Reflection pass complete.

**memory.md** - added: formal 7% letter received {{D:-1}}, 60-day notice clock running from that date; LTA proposal ready but unsent pending your go.

**skills/** - no new skill; the LTA-basket approach is already captured in the price-deltas CSV method.

**inbox/** - moved the Lam price letter to inbox/read.

Prepared the LTA proposal for Whitfield - saved to artifacts/{{D:0}}-lam-lta-proposal.md.

Core terms as agreed: 3-year LTA on the top-10 basket (71% of spend) at +2%, quarterly volume floor at 85% of trailing average, catalog tail at list. Explicit clause keeping spares pricing separate from any service agreement.

Blended effective increase: ~3.4% vs the announced 7% - saving roughly $39k/yr against the letter.

It is drafted, not sent - per the charter I don't send external proposals autonomously. Review it in Files and say the word.

Checked memory.md and the inbox first. The formal 7% letter landed yesterday, which starts the 60-day notice clock - our LTA proposal is drafted and the numbers still hold (blended ~3.4% effective vs 7% announced, ~$39k/yr saved).

Open decision: when to put the proposal in front of Whitfield. History says they settle fastest when a volume commit is on the table before the increase takes effect, so I'd send this week. What would you like me to do?
